chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

When Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام was killed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instructed Fāṭimah عليها السلام to go to Asmāʾ bint ʿUmays and her womenfolk and to prepare food for them for three days. Thus, this sunnah (prophetic tradition) came into practice.

key_terms.أَمَرَ: commanded; indicates the instruction of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the established prophetic tradition or normative practice
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ: three days; the duration mentioned for this support
key_terms.طَعَامًا: food prepared for the household of the bereaved
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, daughter of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.قُتِلَ: was killed; refers to the death of Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah regarding preparing food for a bereaved family after a death?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that after the martyrdom of Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم directed that food be prepared for the bereaved household for three days. It indicates an established sunnah of supporting grieving families through practical care during mourning.
